verdict.rationale: Docs confirm alerting on any telemetry signal (NRQL-based alerts, threshold config) and routing notifications to the correct team/system (new-relic-docs-34, -5, -25, -21), covering the core alerting and routing capability. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of alert grouping/correlation or silencing/muting of notifications, key parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of issue grouping/correlation, mute/silence rules, and any independent hands-on confirmation of these workflows.
